title: Research: transfer-coupled (5,1,1) 7q readout obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Answers the transfer-coupled open question left by [#2779](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2779) on the [#2715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2715) / [#2761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2761) lineage in the five-source common-B mutable-source alphabet of [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898): can a shared prefix, priced transfer `C≥1`, and divergent suffixes undercut tariff `436` at total `Q=7` after a complete dirty bill?

Scoped to maximal-sharing shape `(p,a,b)=(5,1,1)` (two length-6 walks, prefix counted once).

| Schedule | Covering pairs | Min R | Min fair X at min R | Tariff floor | Undercuts 436? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Partitioned dual (#2779) | — | 112 | — | ≥490 | no |
| Transfer-coupled `(5,1,1)` | **8749440** | **84** | **9** | **≥452** | **no** |
| Same-walk even-subset (#2686) | — | 82 | — | ≥442 at X=6 | no |

Every covering distinct-label `(5,1,1)` dual has `R∈{84,88,90}`. On the `R=84` layer, fair shared-prefix XOR billing with `C=1` is at least `9`. Abstract tariff `38·7+2·84+2·9=452>436`.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2779](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2779) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/transfer-coupled-7q-obstruction/`.
Tip: `adb647eba5842812b36e67fe1aa2be5ecdff6b37`.

Exact: min R **84**, min fair X **9**, tariff floor **452**; no undercut of 436.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/transfer-coupled-7q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/transfer-coupled-7q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/transfer-coupled-7q-obstruction/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/transfer-coupled-7q-obstruction/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/transfer-coupled-7q-obstruction
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_TRANSFER_COUPLED_7Q_OBSTRUCTION covering=8749440 min_R=84 min_fair_X=9 tariff_floor=452 answers_transfer_coupled_511 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_TRANSFER_COUPLED_7Q covering=8749440 min_R=84 min_fair_X=9 tariff_floor=452 ... answers_transfer_coupled_511 no_new_kappa
PASS_TRANSFER_COUPLED_7Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/transfer-coupled-7q-obstruction outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#2779](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2779) (partitioned dual), [#2761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2761), [#2686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2686). Freestanding transfer-coupled `(5,1,1)` fixture; no competing open PR at refresh.
